### Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows (x64) | `Kubron_<version>_windows-amd64.zip` |
| Linux (x64) | `Kubron_<version>_linux-amd64.tar.gz` |
| Linux (x64, Debian/Ubuntu) | `kubron_<version>_amd64.deb` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `Kubron_<version>_macos-universal.zip` |

Checksums: `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Build provenance: `gh attestation verify <file> --repo 24DSO-labs/kubron`.

> The builds are not code-signed yet. Windows SmartScreen may warn (More info → Run anyway). On macOS, right-click the app and choose Open, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine Kubron.app`. On Linux, GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1 are required.
